    Endpoint facts for Lemma 4.6 #

    Edges at the endpoints 0 and n of a string of positive length, and extraction of extending arrows from the counting inequalities.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.in_zero_iff {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hw : w.NoForks) (hn : 0 < w.len) :
    (∃ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a i = some 0) ↔ (w.first hn).2 = false
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.out_zero_iff {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hw : w.NoForks) (hn : 0 < w.len) :
    (∃ (a : D.Q.A) (j : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a 0 = some j) ↔ (w.first hn).2 = true
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.in_last_iff {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hw : w.NoForks) (hn : 0 < w.len) :
    (∃ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a i = some (Fin.last w.len)) ↔ (w.last hn).2 = true
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.out_last_iff {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hw : w.NoForks) (hn : 0 < w.len) :
    (∃ (a : D.Q.A) (j : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a (Fin.last w.len) = some j) ↔ (w.last hn).2 = false
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.zero_ne_last {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hw : w.NoForks) (hn : 0 < w.len) :
    0 ≠ Fin.last w.len
